description: Agent-based diffusion-of-adoption model on a social network simulating how individuals adopt a pro-social behavior (e.g., an energy-saving program) under peer influence, targeted campaign exposures, and time-bound policy incentives.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the social network and initializes agent attributes, thresholds, and neighbor indices with assortative rewiring for homophily.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  set RNG seed
  create N=population_size Person agents
  for each agent i:
    income_i ~ LogNormal(mu=income_lognormal_mu, sigma=income_lognormal_sigma)
    openness_i ~ Beta(a=openness_beta_a, b=openness_beta_b)
    threshold_i ~ Clamp(Normal(mean=diffusion.threshold_mean, sd=diffusion.threshold_std), 0, 1)
    adopted_i ~ Bernoulli(initial_adoption_rate)
    adoption_day_i = 0 if adopted_i else -1
    camp_memory_i = 0.0; exposures_today_i = 0
  G = WattsStrogatzGraph(N, k=network.average_degree, p=network.rewire_prob)
  perform assortative rewiring for a fraction f=network.assortative_rewire_fraction to increase similarity by openness using homophily_strength
  compute neighbor_index for each agent
emit network.graph, agents.attributes, network.neighbors_index
notes: Assortative rewiring swaps edge endpoints to maximize similarity in openness based on homophily_strength.
Watts–Strogatz preserves approximate average degree while adding small-world properties.

modules.name: CampaignScheduler
modules.description: Allocates daily campaign impressions subject to budget and frequency caps, targeting non-adopters with precision reflecting model parameter.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day in [campaign.start_day, campaign.end_day] and budget_remaining > 0:
  desired_impressions = (population_size / 1000) * campaign.daily_impressions_per_1000
  afford_impressions = floor((budget_remaining / campaign.cpm_cost) * 1000)
  impressions_today = min(desired_impressions, afford_impressions)
  reset exposures_today_i = 0 for all i
  scoring for each agent i:
    if not adopted_i:
      score_i = campaign.targeting_precision * openness_i + (1 - campaign.targeting_precision) * 0.5
    else:
      score_i = (1 - campaign.targeting_precision) * 0.1
  sample agents proportionally to score_i with replacement until impressions_today allocated, respecting frequency_cap_per_day per agent
  for each exposure allocated to agent i:
    exposures_today_i += 1
  spend_today = ceil(sum_exposures / 1000) * campaign.cpm_cost
  budget_remaining -= spend_today
else:
  set exposures_today_i = 0 for all i
  spend_today = 0
emit campaign.exposures_agent_daily, campaign.spend_daily
notes: Targeting favors high-openness non-adopters when targeting_precision is high.
CPM billing rounds up to the nearest thousand impressions.

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Activates a subsidy incentive for eligible agents within a time window, tracks beneficiaries, and outputs per-agent incentive influence scalars.

notes: Influence scalar is normalized by eligibility threshold to keep values in [0,1].
Take-up delay prevents immediate effect on the day window opens.

requirements: access to per-agent income and adoption_day

modules.name: InfluenceDiffusion
modules.description: Determines adoption transitions based on social influence, campaign exposures (with memory), and policy incentive influence.

update_rule.pseudocode:
new_adopters = 0
for each agent i where adopted_i == False:
  neigh = neighbors_index[i]
  s_fraction = mean(adopted_j for j in neigh) if len(neigh) > 0 else 0
  E = exposures_today_i
  exposure_effect = min(1.0, E * campaign.persuasion_lift_per_exposure)
  camp_memory_i = diffusion.memory_decay_rate * camp_memory_i + exposure_effect
  U = diffusion.social_influence_weight * (s_fraction - threshold_i) + diffusion.campaign_influence_weight * camp_memory_i + diffusion.policy_influence_weight * policy_influence_i
  p = clip( diffusion.base_adoption_prob + sigmoid(U / max(1e-6, (1.0 + diffusion.noise_scale))) , 0.0, 1.0)
  if rand() < p:
    adopted_i = True
    adoption_day_i = day
    new_adopters += 1
emit adoption.state, adoption.new_adopters_daily
notes: Threshold_i represents personal resistance; U compares social fraction to threshold.
Noise_scale dilates the logistic sensitivity; larger values flatten the response.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily system-level observables and applies optional smoothing/report lag for comparison to data.

update_rule.pseudocode:
N = population_size
adoption_rate = mean(adopted_i for all i)
new_adopters = adoption.new_adopters_daily
cumulative_adoption = sum(adopted_i for all i)
mean_exposures = mean(exposures_today_i for all i)
beneficiaries = policy.beneficiaries_daily
spend = campaign.spend_daily
if aggregator.smoothing_window_days > 1:
  apply moving average of window W to each time series
if aggregator.report_lag_days > 0:
  shift reported series by lag
emit all observables
notes: Smoothing and lag are applied to emitted time series to match reporting characteristics of the data.

parameters.description: Average degree in the initial Watts–Strogatz network.
Rewiring probability for Watts–Strogatz small-world generation.
Weight of openness similarity in assortative rewiring (0=no homophily, 1=max).
Fraction of edges subject to assortative rewiring to increase homophily.
Baseline daily probability to adopt absent any influence.
Weight of social fraction relative to personal threshold.
Weight applied to cumulative campaign memory effect.
Weight applied to policy incentive influence scalar.
Mean of the normal distribution for agent thresholds (clipped to [0,1]).
Standard deviation for thresholds distribution.
Daily exponential decay rate for campaign memory (0=no memory, 1=perfect carryover).
Scale of logistic dilatation to capture unobserved heterogeneity.
Desired daily impressions per 1000 population.
Weight of openness in targeting score; higher targets likely adopters.
Max exposures per agent per day.
Incremental effect per exposure prior to decay and weighting.
Total media budget in currency units.
Cost per thousand impressions.
Day index when campaign starts.
Day index when campaign ends.
Per-eligible-agent incentive level (normalized to [0,1] influence).
Start day for policy incentive window.
End day for policy incentive window.
Income threshold for policy eligibility.
Minimum days before eligible agents respond to the incentive.
Moving average window applied to outputs (1 disables smoothing).
Reporting lag applied to observables for alignment with data.
Total number of simulated days.

observables.formula_or_field: count(eligible non-adopters influenced by policy on day t)

algorithms.WattsStrogatzHomophily: WS small-world graph with post-generation assortative rewiring proportional to homophily strength.
algorithms.TargetedImpressionAllocation: Weighted sampling with replacement respecting per-agent frequency caps and budget-limited impressions.
algorithms.ThresholdedLogisticAdoption: Adoption probability via logistic of weighted influences minus threshold with baseline floor and noise dilation.
algorithms.ExponentialDecayMemory: Campaign exposure effect accumulates with daily exponential decay.
